_comment: Extra quests (new content, not part of the shipped game). Stage lists name BOTH worlds where a place exists twice (Asuka and Amaterasu), and night/story variants count as the same place. 'unlock' keeps a quest out of the log until you have played far enough; 'acceptAt' makes a quest acceptable only while standing in that place (a notice board); 'offer' / 'turnIn' hand a quest out and take it back through one of the game's own NPCs (npc ids come from the scene files); 'talk' objectives are conversations with real NPCs. Species, stage ids, coordinates, npc ids and item names are checked against the game's own data by tools/check_quests.py. Wanted-board jobs are generated at run time (generateBounty in quests.js) and are not listed here.

quests.title: Central Park pest control
quests.text: Leomon cannot leave the gym, and Kunemon keep wandering into Central Park. Thin them out.

offer.name: Leomon
lines: Hey there. The Kunemon have been wandering into Central Park again, and I cannot leave the gym to deal with them.
If you could thin out three of them, I would be grateful. I will make it worth your while.
doneLines: Three less to worry about. Thank you.

quests.title: Wire Forest survey
quests.text: Leomon wants to know whether the road into the Wire Forest is safe. Walk the entrance and the forest beyond it, then report back.

offer.name: Leomon
lines: You have been keeping the park clear. That is good work.
Now I need eyes further out. Walk the Wire Forest entrance and the forest beyond it, and tell me whether the road is safe.
doneLines: So the road holds. That is a weight off my mind.

quests.title: East Station bounty: forest greens
quests.text: Plants are overrunning the Kicking Forest path. Cut four of them back.

quests.title: South Station bounty: swamp pests
quests.text: The Bulk Swamp crossing is infested. Clear four of the worst offenders.

quests.title: The quiet route
quests.text: Couriers lose time to fights in the Wire Forest. Show a fight-free way through.

objectives.label: Cross the Wire Forest entrance from the north-west gate to the south gate without a fight

quests.title: Card ladder: first steps
quests.text: Prove yourself at the card table. Beat any three tamers.

quests.title: Card ladder: rising duelist
quests.text: Word is spreading. Beat six tamers in all.

quests.title: Double trouble in Central Park
quests.text: Two pests came out of the long grass at once. Face a Kunemon and a Tapirmon back to back, with no time to heal in between.

objectives.label: Beat a Kunemon and then a Tapirmon, back to back

offer.name: Leomon
lines: Something odd happened. Two pests came out of the long grass at the same time, a Kunemon and a Tapirmon.
Could you face them back to back? No time to heal in between. It is harder than it sounds.
doneLines: Both of them at once, and you are still standing. Impressive.

quests.title: Seiryu's rematch
quests.text: Word is the Seiryu leader's team will take on all comers again. The same three fighters, in the same order.

objectives.label: Beat the three fighters in a row

quests.title: Seiryu's rematch: the hard way
quests.text: The same three fighters, but they have been training. Stronger and tougher.

objectives.label: Beat the three trained fighters in a row

quests.title: Three leaders, one afternoon
quests.text: Take on the Seiryu, Suzaku and Byakko teams one after another. No healing between rounds.

objectives.label: Beat all three leaders' teams in a row (eight fights)

quests.title: Circuit Board cartographer
quests.text: The underground Circuit Board boards are not on any map. Chart six different ones.

quests.title: Before and after
quests.text: The Main Lobby is not always the same place. See it as it is now, and again once the city has changed.

objectives.label: Visit the Main Lobby once as Asuka City and once as Amaterasu City

quests.title: Arena qualifiers
quests.text: Three qualifier matches, back to back, on the arena floor. The game's own tournament rounds were never filled in; these are new.

objectives.label: Win three qualifier matches in a row on the arena floor

quests.title: Guilmon cannot find his tamer
quests.text: Your Guilmon keeps looking past you for a tamer who is not there. Follow the trail and bring them together.

objectives.name: Agumon
lines: Guilmon is looking for his tamer? He is not in the station.
I saw a tamer with a very familiar hat heading for Qing Long City. Try there.

objectives.name: Takato
lines: Guilmon? Is that you? I looked everywhere!
I am sorry I kept you waiting. Thank you for bringing him to me.
